audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Ryze wins Level 1 and Level 6; packet levelChart says Skill at Level 1 and K'Sante at Level 6, and the prose itself says All Out wins the 6 all-in.
audit.why: K'Sante's R (120s rank 1) launches Ryze through a wall and All Out dashes after; Ryze's R (Realm Warp, 180s) is a portal, not a combat ult, so 6 is a K'Sante spike. At 1 neither has burst — Ryze's Overload pokes at 1000 range but has no kill threat.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Skill (5/10), Level 6 = K'Sante (6/10); both layers flipped in matched pairs.

audit.why: Spikes at Lvl 3 (full Q-W), Lvl 6 (R into All Out), first item (Iceborn Gauntlet), 2+ items (Ryze's Archangel's scaling) are accurate; only the ability naming inside them was wrong.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spike timings, corrected the ability chains inside them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly described Ryze's root as a 'Q-E root combo' (Overload into Spell Flux). Riot's text: Rune Prison (W) roots only if the target already has Flux (E) on it — Overload (Q) does not root.
audit.why: The root chain is E then W. Overload is a 1000-range projectile nuke with a 5s base cooldown that his other spells reset; Rune Prison is 615 range on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and is the real punish window.
audit.corrected: All references changed to Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W), with the 615 range and ~10-11s cooldown stated where it makes the advice concrete.
sources: kit file: ryze W text 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted'

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] and late told the reader to 'peel with All Out's recall'. K'Sante's R has no recall — it knocks the target back through walls, then he dashes after them.
audit.why: Riot's R text: knocks an enemy back through any wall, then K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them. The peel tool is the wall-knockback, used before All Out, not a recall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice was generic ('when it is down').
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 down to 9s at rank 5 — that is the punish window and it is short, so the commit has to be immediate.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into mid and the spikes.

edits.before: Ryze has no Level 1 burst, but neither do you with only Q — farm marks and respect his Q-E root if you over-extend.
edits.after: Ryze has no Level 1 burst, but neither do you with only Q — farm marks and respect his E-into-W root if you over-extend.

edits.before: All Out converts to a duelist and dashes through him — you survive his combo and run him down before realm warp.
edits.after: R launches him through the wall and All Out dashes after — you eat Rune Prison (11s) and kill him before Realm Warp.

edits.before: He out-scales hard: Archangel's-stacked spell spam ignores your armor entirely — peel with All Out's recall, don't 1v1 him.
edits.after: He out-scales hard: Archangel's-stacked spell spam ignores your armor entirely — peel with your R knockback through a wall, don't 1v1 him.

edits.before: Full Q-W combo online — W a committed Ryze and Q3 knock-up to punish him before his Q-E root resets stack.
edits.after: Full Q-W combo online — W a committed Ryze and Q3 knock-up to punish him while Rune Prison sits on its 11s cooldown.

edits.before: All Out converts your tank stats to a duelist profile and dashes through him — you survive his Q-E-W burst and run him down before realm warp escapes.
edits.after: All Out converts your tank stats to a duelist profile and dashes through him — you survive his Flux-into-Rune Prison root and run him down before Realm Warp escapes.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet + your Q slow lock him in melee range where his short Q-E root combo can't kite you out.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet + your Q slow lock him in melee range where his 615-range Flux-root combo can't kite you out.

edits.before: Ryze has no real Level 1 damage threat and no escape until his W root and Flash, so don't panic at his early poke — just farm with the tip of your Q (Ntofo Strikes) and stack your passive marks. The danger is his Q-E root combo: if he lands Spell Flux then Overload he locks you for a chain, so don't walk into his range with your W on cooldown. Once you hit Level 3 your full Q-W is online and the lane flips — he's squishy and immobile.
edits.after: Ryze has no real Level 1 damage threat and no escape but Flash, so don't panic at his 1000-range Overload poke — just farm with the tip of your Q (Ntofo Strikes) and stack your passive marks. The danger is the root: Spell Flux (E) first, then Rune Prison (W) roots instead of slowing, so don't stand in his 615 range with your W on cooldown. Once you hit Level 3 your full Q-W is online and the lane flips — he's squishy and immobile.

edits.before: This is your window. Path Maker (W) charges through his Q-E-W burst as unstoppable and damage-resistant, then slams him for a long stun if you pin him to a wall — and his only answer is to blow his root and pray. At 6, All Out turns your tank stats into a duelist profile and dashes through him; you survive his combo and chunk him before he can realm-warp out. Force every all-in here while his single root is his whole defense and your bulk plus first-item Iceborn keeps him pinned in melee.
edits.after: This is your window. Path Maker (W) charges through his Flux-root burst taking reduced damage, then knocks back and stuns him if you pin him to a wall — and his only answer is to blow his root and pray. At 6, R throws him through the wall and All Out dashes after him; you survive his combo and chunk him before he can realm-warp out. Force every all-in here while his single 10s root is his whole defense and your bulk plus first-item Iceborn keeps him pinned in melee.

edits.before: Ryze is a hard scaler and this is where he reclaims it — once his Tear stacks into Archangel's and he has 2+ items, his Q-E spell spam outdamages everything your armor stacking gives you, because none of it touches his AP. Don't try to 1v1 a fed Ryze in the open; your job becomes peeling. Use All Out's recall to yank him off your carry, and lean on the lead you should have built before ~25 minutes — if the game goes long on his terms, his realm warp and reset chains win.
edits.after: Ryze is a hard scaler and this is where he reclaims it — once his Tear stacks into Archangel's and he has 2+ items, his Q-E spell spam outdamages everything your armor stacking gives you, because none of it touches his AP. Don't try to 1v1 a fed Ryze in the open; your job becomes peeling. Use R to launch him through a wall away from your carry, and lean on the lead you should have built before ~25 minutes — if the game goes long on his terms, his Realm Warp and reset chains win.

edits.before: Use Path Maker's unstoppable charge to eat his Q-E-W burst, then All Out him on the spot
edits.after: Use Path Maker's damage-reduced charge to eat his Flux-root burst, then All Out him on the spot

edits.before: Land Q-E (Overload into Spell Flux) root chains to kite you while spamming resets
edits.after: Land Spell Flux then Rune Prison to root you, then kite you with Overload resets
